boundaries.note: No play-offs: Ligue 1's bottom two are replaced by Ligue 2's top two.

notes: Both professional levels are 16-club single-table double round robins (30 rounds) with a straight 2-up/2-down link and no play-offs at either end. Ligue 2 expanded from 14 to 16 for 2024-25; the top flight was 14 in 2024-25 and returned to 16 in 2025-26. Season runs October to June: 2026-27 was postponed from 3 to 17 October 2026 and ends 6 June 2027. National 1 (level 3) is not in our database, so SEN2 is closed downward here although clubs really are relegated into it. Sponsored name of the top flight: Ligue 1 Lonase BET.
